claims.source_title: ChatGPT becomes a full Chrome browser assistant that reads and acts on your open tabs
claims.supporting_quote: OpenAI's updated Chrome extension lets ChatGPT access open browser tabs, sum up content, and use "Computer Use" in Work mode to fill out forms or compare products across several tabs.
